product_one_liner.value: Leena AI provides prebuilt and customizable AI colleagues that automate employee support and back-office workflows across HR, IT, finance, and procurement for large enterprises.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage and About page describe the enterprise AI colleagues and covered business functions.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page is available. It describes pricing models and a custom-quote process rather than fixed published prices.

named_customers.notes: These are named in the company’s customer stories and case studies.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: The company announcement identifies Leena AI as headquartered in New York; its About page lists New York among its offices. LinkedIn lists San Francisco as a company location, but the cited company announcement explicitly calls New York its headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company About page says it was founded in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: The blog contains multiple engineering-focused posts, including an engineering-led benchmarking post by SVP of Engineering Mayank Kapoor and an enterprise AI security post by co-founder and CTO Anand Prajapati.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site contains multiple product and integration articles, including pages on OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, model configuration, and benchmarks.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists openings, but none of the role titles shown is an AI, machine-learning, data-science, applied-scientist, research-scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer-vision role. Engineering roles whose descriptions mention AI do not qualify under the title-based rule.

model_provider.value: The public documentation names OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), and Google (Gemini) as supported model providers; it also documents Azure OpenAI.
model_provider.notes: The documentation describes model-provider integrations and configuration options; it does not claim the product uses only one exclusive provider.

compliance_certs.notes: These are named on Leena AI’s Trust & Security materials. PCI DSS is not included because the cited materials do not name it.

last_funding.notes: Leena AI reported IBM Ventures’ strategic investment announced October 19, 2026. Public announcements reviewed do not disclose the amount; amount_usd is 0 to represent undisclosed, not a claimed zero-dollar investment.

raised_18mo.notes: IBM Ventures announced a strategic investment in October 2026, within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The company’s job board has an Enterprise Sales Development Representative role and a Senior Account Executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: Leena AI introduced Leena Forge on October 14, 2026, within the six-month window; the post describes a new automation platform, not a bug fix or UI change.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current leadership page is small enough to review and does not indicate a C-level or VP-level join or departure in the period. The identified SVP Engineering appointment announcement for Mayank Kapoor is from 2025, outside the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: All three systems are explicitly listed on Leena AI’s integrations page.
